mapper.select: SELECT u.id FROM auth_governance.principal u JOIN auth_governance.membership m ON m.principal_id=u.id WHERE m.id=#{member} AND m.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} FOR SHARE OF u
SELECT id FROM auth_governance.membership WHERE id=#{member} AND tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} FOR SHARE

SELECT m.id membership_id,m.generation,m.version FROM auth_governance.membership m JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id=m.tenant_id JOIN auth_governance.access_delegation d ON d.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND d.membership_id=m.id AND d.generation=m.generation JOIN auth_governance.tenant_application a ON a.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND a.application_id=d.application_id AND a.environment=d.environment WHERE m.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND d.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND d.environment=#{p.environment} AND m.id=#{member} AND m.generation=#{generation} AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.kind='HUMAN' AND t.status='ACTIVE' AND d.enabled AND a.enabled AND m.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to>clock_timestamp())

SELECT m.id membership_id,m.generation,m.version FROM auth_governance.membership m JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id=m.tenant_id JOIN auth_governance.access_delegation d ON d.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND d.membership_id=m.id AND d.generation=m.generation JOIN auth_governance.tenant_application a ON a.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND a.application_id=d.application_id AND a.environment=d.environment WHERE m.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND d.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND d.environment=#{p.environment} AND (m.id,m.generation) IN (#{a.membershipId},#{a.generation}) AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.kind='HUMAN' AND t.status='ACTIVE' AND d.enabled AND a.enabled AND m.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to>clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 100

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.audit_event a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND a.operation='REVOKE_GRANT' AND a.target_id=#{id} AND a.target_version=#{version} AND a.command_id=#{command} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.access_grant g WHERE g.id=a.target_id AND g.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND g.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND g.environment=#{p.environment}))
SELECT FROM auth_governance.access_review_task WHERE AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM auth_governance.access_review_task WHERE AND id>#{after} AND membership_id=#{member} ORDER BY id LIMIT 21

SELECT id,task_id,tenant_id,application_id,environment,grant_id,original_version,original_json::text,original_hash,state,version,reason,revoke_command,confirmed_operation_id FROM auth_governance.access_review_item WHERE AND task_id=#{id} ORDER BY id LIMIT 101
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.access_review_item SET state=#{state},version=version+1,reason=#{reason},confirmed_operation_id=#{operation} WHERE AND task_id=#{task} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE auth_governance.access_review_item SET state='CANCELLED',version=version+1,reason=#{reason} WHERE AND task_id=#{id} AND state IN ('PENDING','INVESTIGATE')

UPDATE auth_governance.access_review_task t SET version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp(),state=CASE WHEN #{cancel} OR t.state='CANCELLED' THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.access_review_item i WHERE i.task_id=t.id AND i.state NOT IN ('KEPT','REVOKED')) THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.access_review_item i WHERE i.task_id=t.id AND i.state='INVESTIGATE') THEN 'NEEDS_INVESTIGATION' ELSE 'RUNNING' END WHERE t.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND t.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND t.environment=#{p.environment} AND t.id=#{id} AND t.version=#{version}

UPDATE auth_governance.access_review_task SET responsible_membership_id=#{member},responsible_generation=#{generation},version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND state<>'COMPLETED'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM auth_governance.access_grant WHERE AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
